title: batch streaming JSONL frame
description: `rtlscanner batch --json` streams one of these compact JSON objects per query line (JSONL / NDJSON), flushed as each query finishes. On success `result` carries the exact envelope the equivalent single command would emit; on failure `error` carries the message. The batch process exits 0 even when individual queries fail — a non-zero exit means the design could not be loaded at all.

id.description: The query's trailing `# label`, else its 1-based sequence number (blank/comment lines are skipped and do not consume a number).

ok.description: True when the query ran and produced a result.

result.description: Present when ok=true: the standard per-tool `--json` envelope (see the per-tool schemas).

error.description: Present when ok=false: the failure message.
